comments.body:
> needed for https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RHEL-160859

These are upstream branches if RHEL needs it it must be backported on the internal RHEL gitlab repo.

For upstream we said only critical bug fixes, given there seem to be no upstream reports I would not consider it critical. that said I would be fine merging and we do a release only once there is more stuff that needs a release which I assume will be soon enough anyway.

cc @mheon @mtrmac

> I don’t have a strong opinion on backporting. “Container commit during build does not work with unusual but valid options” might warrant a backport. I’m comfortable with backporting the xattr mapping changes; OTOH the ID mapping code was always hard for me to comprehend in its entirety, that makes me more worried.

unfortunately that is not enough, without the ID mapping change the reproducer we have for Buildah still fails
